facts.fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab reports that a workshop led by the Ministry of Health Zanzibar and the lab validated end-to-end data flows from vertical-programme and point-of-service systems into ZHMIS, Zanzibar's HMIS, through the Zanzibar Health Information Layer, and moved the integration towards the live environment; the page is undated, so its published date, itself a proxy, is used.

systems.country_label: ZHMIS (the page calls it the national HMIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Health Zanzibar leads the work described; ownership of ZHMIS is not stated
Ministry of Health Zanzibar, with the UDSM DHIS2 Lab giving technical leadership

systems.tiers: not stated; an authoritative registry used as single source of truth
point of service; not otherwise stated

note: Everything described is in Zanzibar, not the mainland. ZHMIS is classed hmis on the page's own description (the HMIS, routine reporting); its platform is not named. The date is a proxy on an undated page.
